list.title: Support tickets
list.description: Create and follow up on your support requests.

new.title: Create support ticket
new.description: Send your request details to the GodarAI support team.
new.detailsDescription: Include the information needed to investigate the issue.
new.messageHint: Plain text up to 10,000 characters. Do not send secrets such as API keys.

states.emptyDescription: Create a ticket when you need help from the GodarAI team.

reply.title: Send reply
reply.closed: This ticket is closed and read-only. Create a new ticket for a new request.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.policy: Up to 5 files, 10 MiB each and 25 MiB total. PDF, images, text, CSV, LOG and JSON are supported.

validation.subject: Subject must be between 5 and 160 characters.
validation.messageRequired: Enter a message or attach at least one file.
validation.fileCount: A message can have up to 5 files.
validation.fileSize: Each file must be 10 MiB or smaller.
validation.totalSize: Combined file size must be 25 MiB or smaller.
validation.fileType: One of the selected file types is not allowed.

errors.create: The ticket could not be created.
errors.reply: The message could not be sent.
errors.rating: The rating could not be saved.
